subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Amplify
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Lessen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Amplify"** means to increase the volume of sound, to make something more intense, or to enlarge or extend something. (बढ़ाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The new speaker system will amplify the sound in the auditorium.
 
 
 
• **"Lessen"** refers to making something smaller in size, amount, or degree; to reduce. (घटाना)
 
 
• **Example: **They are trying to lessen the impact of the new tax laws on small businesses.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Amplify'** is **'Lessen'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Lessen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enrich **(समृद्ध करना): To improve or enhance the quality or value of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Traveling can enrich your understanding of different cultures.
 
 
 
• **Exaggerate **(बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना): To describe something as larger, better, or worse than it really is.
 
 
• **Example: **He tends to exaggerate his achievements to impress others.
 
 
 
• **Dislike** (नापसंद): A feeling of not liking or being opposed to something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a strong dislike for spicy food.
